title: Arena loss 11/22/2026: Anvil, Sycophant, Mountain Folk

sources.author: dominion.games
sources.note: Rated game: Gemini 4 Neon (high) as AstraDominion lost 34-49 to a human at level 56

sources.author: dominion-agent-review
sources.note: Neon vs Neon on this kingdom, one seat told the Anvil/Sycophant insight: the told seat won 3 of 3 (g20, g24, g27)

quality_note: One human game showed the line, and three seeded Neon-vs-Neon games confirmed it: the told seat won all three, twice moving first and once moving second, by 9, 6 and 12 VP. The planned three further games were not played (Neon's quota ran out).

kingdom.setup_notes: Fool's Heirloom, Lucky Coin, replaces a Copper in each starting deck. Mountain Folk is the Ally (Sycophant is a Liaison); each player starts with 1 Favor.

edition: Current (second-edition) texts, as on dominion.games in November 2026.
